data.name: Darkhaven
data.detailed_description:
Darkhaven is a dark-fantasy isometric ARPG set in the aftermath of a total collapse of civilization. You are a survivor in a world where the wild lands and monsters have reclaimed the ruins of long-dead empires. To survive, you must venture beyond the safety of your meager stronghold to hunt the remnants of evil and become the hero this world awaits. Unearth items of legendary power, learn arcane skill trees, and master a combat system that rewards skill and positioning over simple stat-checks.

Every Player’s Game is Unique

Darkhaven moves away from the disconnected, "hallway-and-room" logic of traditional random layouts. We use ecological rules to stitch together biomes, handcrafted points of interest, and terrain that make sense. Every world is unique, yet feels cohesive with a rich implied history. Exploration isn't just a path to the next set of mobs; it’s the discovery of a vast and living realm.

Totally Dynamic Worlds

The terrain in Darkhaven is fully deformable. You can dig into the earth to harvest resources, discover hidden caves, tunnel through dungeon walls, or rebuild ruined fortresses. Drain lakes to uncover sunken ruins or redirect flows of lava to form an impassable moat. You can also build. Raise the earth to create islands, fortify defensive positions, and construct everything from bridges to entire settlements. The land is your dominion, and its destiny is in your hands. 

Lurking Horrors 

Malevolent forces prey on the remains of this dying realm. Tendrils of darkness worm through the veil from other planes, tearing open rifts in reality. Each breach spawns legions of horrors and spreads corruption that physically transforms the landscape. These enemies are powerful and hungry, and every invasion leaves permanent scars. While you can fight them back and rebuild, the world remembers. Craters, ruins, and the structural changes left by these incursions remain as a lasting record of your epic battles.    

Build-Inspiring Itemization

Itemization is the heartbeat of Darkhaven. We avoid the "balanced banality" and tiny incremental percentages that are common in many modern titles. There are no “green arrow” decisions. Instead, you will find gear that feels genuinely powerful for its level, and rare items that remain viable far beyond their expected power band. Finding a "too good" item should be a moment of excitement that inspires your build decisions, not something to be nerfed.

We’re building on our past work with the next generation of relics, runes (and rune words), and build-defining set items to add layers of interesting choices. This system is supported by trading and finely tuned drop rates. By focusing on the value of rare finds, we ensure that trading remains a cornerstone of the experience. Many rare items are useful for adapting your current build, while advanced players chasing specific archetypes can look to others to fill out those extremely rare, missing pieces.

Tactical Combat and Truly Open Movement

In Darkhaven, your character isn't stopped by a fallen log or a shallow stream. You are free to jump, climb, swim, and dash, making verticality a core part of the experience. Scale a fortress wall to gain a height advantage or use a well-timed leap to clear projectiles and heavy attacks. This freedom of movement transforms the environment into a tactical playground where your skill is just as important as your stats.

The result is combat that is never a mindless grind. To match your skill, our monster AI is designed with distinct behaviors and unique abilities; they don't just rush you in a mass. You must learn to read your opponents and utilize situational skills. Whether you are lashing out to pull a high-priority threat into close range or dashing to reposition for a killing blow, success depends on outmaneuvering your foes.

Persistent, Interconnected Realms

Play solo, join a co-op adventure, or enter high-stakes PvP-enabled realms. Darkhaven supports persistent online worlds where your progress and your impact on the land remain even when you are offline. We are building unprecedented, flexible ways to define the rules of your world and connect realms together. Anything from a single-player journey to a massively interconnected, MMO-scale network of realms is possible. 

Total Modding Freedom

We are building Darkhaven to be fully moddable from the ground up. Using our in-client editor, you can create your own items, monsters, classes, and quests in real-time, even while playing concurrently with others. Whether you want to design a single set-piece or an entirely new ruleset for a persistent online world, the tools are built directly into the game.

data.short_description: Darkhaven is a next-generation ARPG brought to you by many of the original creators of Diablo and Diablo II. Explore a procedurally generated and fully destructible open world unlike any other in this solo or multiplayer adventure.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon VII or equivalent GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600-XT with 6GB+ GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
